title: ActiveDPO: Active Direct Preference Optimization for Sample-Efficient Alignment
authors_zh: Xiaoqiang Lin、Arun Verma、Zhongxiang Dai、Daniela Rus、See-Kiong Ng、Bryan Kian Hsiang Low（新加坡国立大学、SMART、中山大学深圳校区、麻省理工学院）
paper_type_zh: 主动偏好数据获取与直接偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计标签高效偏好优化、且需要支付昂贵人工判断成本的读者。
one_line: ActiveDPO uses the target policy's projected implicit-reward gradients to actively acquire diverse, high-uncertainty preference pairs for iterative DPO.
ActiveDPO 利用目标策略投影后的隐式奖励梯度，主动获取多样且高不确定性的偏好对，再进行迭代式 DPO 训练。
why: It turns the current policy's own gradient geometry into an explicit and theoretically motivated rule for purchasing preference labels.
inclusion_reason: It changes which preference pairs consume annotation budget by ranking model-specific gradient uncertainty before DPO training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Direct preference optimization needs pairwise labels, yet obtaining fresh human judgments is expensive. Selecting pairs at random can spend the limited labeling budget on comparisons that are redundant for the particular policy being aligned, while existing active methods either use heuristic confidence scores or impose restrictive reward assumptions.

ActiveDPO asks which response pairs should be sent to annotators so that each judgment most improves the target policy under a fixed budget. It frames this as active data acquisition for a non-linear implicit reward function: the same language model that will be optimized supplies the uncertainty signal for deciding what to label.

直接偏好优化需要成对偏好标签，但获得新的人工判断十分昂贵。随机选择样本对可能把有限的标注预算花在对特定待对齐策略而言冗余的比较上；现有主动方法则要么依赖启发式置信度分数，要么施加过强的奖励函数假设。

ActiveDPO 询问，在固定预算下应将哪些回答对交给标注者，才能让每个判断最有效地改善目标策略。它将问题表述为非线性隐式奖励函数的主动数据获取：最终要被优化的同一个语言模型，为决定标注什么提供不确定性信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
In DPO, the policy induces an implicit reward for each response relative to a reference policy. ActiveDPO derives an upper bound on reward-difference estimation error and uses the norm of the difference between two implicit-reward gradients, weighted by information from earlier selections, as an uncertainty score.

Large scores identify pairs that are both uncertain for the present policy and complementary to pairs already queried. This makes the acquisition rule policy-specific rather than relying on a separate reward model: a pair is valuable when labeling it is expected to change the reward geometry that DPO actually uses.

在 DPO 中，策略相对于参考策略会为每个回答诱导出隐式奖励。ActiveDPO 推导了奖励差估计误差的上界，并将两个隐式奖励梯度之差的范数作为不确定性分数，同时用先前选择所包含的信息对该分数加权。

高分样本对表示：它既让当前策略不确定，又与已查询的样本对互补。因此，获取规则是策略特定的，而非依赖独立奖励模型：当标注某个样本对预计会改变 DPO 实际采用的奖励几何时，它才具有价值。

title: Method
方法
html:
At every iteration, the current policy regenerates three responses for each sampled prompt, producing pairwise candidates. ActiveDPO computes LoRA gradients for the policy's implicit reward, normalizes them to avoid length bias, randomly projects them to 8,192 dimensions, and greedily selects 50 pairs with the largest diversity-aware gradient uncertainty. The selected pairs are then assigned preference labels and used for DPO.

The authors use batch acquisition so gradients and policy updates need not be recomputed after every individual label. They evaluate Llama-2-7B, Gemma-2B, and Qwen3-4B on TLDR summarization and WebGPT question answering; for feasible repeated experiments, reward models trained on the original human feedback emulate the labels for newly generated pairs.

在每次迭代中，当前策略会为每个采样提示重新生成三个回答，从而形成成对候选。ActiveDPO 计算策略隐式奖励的 LoRA 梯度，对其归一化以避免长度偏差，再随机投影到 8,192 维，并贪心地选择 50 个具有最大、且考虑多样性的梯度不确定性的样本对。被选中的样本对随后获得偏好标签并用于 DPO。

作者采用批量获取，因此不必在每个单独标签后重新计算梯度和更新策略。他们在 TLDR 摘要和 WebGPT 问答上评估 Llama-2-7B、Gemma-2B 和 Qwen3-4B；为使反复实验可行，使用在原始人工反馈上训练的奖励模型，模拟对新生成样本对的标签。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the six reported model-task settings, the curves in the main experiment show higher average reward for policies trained on ActiveDPO-selected pairs than random selection, APO, and APLP at the same sequence of annotation budgets. The paper also reports that the ranking remains favorable in its win-rate plots after comparison with the initial policy.

A controlled study with two differently initialized Gemma models finds that the same three DPO data subsets can rank differently for the two models, supporting the policy-specific premise. Ablations show that gradient normalization improves the WebGPT-Gemma result, while projection dimensions below 8,192 reduce performance and larger dimensions bring little additional gain.

在报告的六个模型—任务设置中，主实验曲线显示：在相同的一系列标注预算下，使用 ActiveDPO 所选样本对训练的策略，其平均奖励高于随机选择、APO 和 APLP。论文还报告，在与初始策略比较的胜率图中，这一排序仍然有利。

一项控制研究使用两个以不同方式初始化的 Gemma 模型，发现同样的三个 DPO 数据子集对两者的排名可能不同，支持了策略特定这一前提。消融实验显示，梯度归一化改善了 WebGPT—Gemma 结果；投影维度低于 8,192 会降低性能，而更高维度几乎不再带来额外增益。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier selection approaches commonly score preference pairs with an external reward model, a confidence heuristic, or a linear latent-reward approximation. ActiveDPO instead derives its criterion from the target DPO policy's own implicit reward and gradient features, connecting the record-selection decision directly to the model that will consume the labeled record.

The diversity matrix also gives the criterion a sequential memory: pairs similar to already selected gradient directions are deprioritized. The contribution is therefore more than replacing one score with another; it defines an iterative contract in which regeneration, model-dependent uncertainty, diverse acquisition, labeling, and DPO updates are coupled.

早期选择方法通常用外部奖励模型、置信度启发式规则或线性潜在奖励近似来为偏好对打分。ActiveDPO 则从目标 DPO 策略自身的隐式奖励和梯度特征推导准则，使记录选择决策直接连接到将消费这些已标注记录的模型。

多样性矩阵还使该准则具有序列记忆：与已选梯度方向相似的样本对会被降低优先级。因此，贡献不只是用一个分数替换另一个分数；它定义了一个耦合了重新生成、模型相关不确定性、多样获取、标注和 DPO 更新的迭代契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method needs forward and backward gradient computation for every candidate pair and additional storage for projected features, so it deliberately trades compute for fewer judgments. The empirical loop uses reward-model oracles instead of newly collected human judgments, the formal guarantee is derived for fully connected networks rather than transformers, and neither a public implementation nor a new preference dataset is declared.
该方法需要为每个候选样本对进行前向和反向梯度计算，并存储额外的投影特征，因此它有意用计算量换取更少的人类判断。实证循环使用奖励模型预言器而非新收集的人工判断，形式化保证是针对全连接网络而不是 Transformer 推导的，论文也没有声明公开实现或新的偏好数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is useful for teams that can generate many response pairs but can afford to annotate only a small fraction of them. It offers a concrete way to make the choice of preference data depend on the evolving target model, and it highlights the operational costs—gradient extraction, projection, and repeated regeneration—that must be budgeted alongside human labeling.
这篇论文适合能够生成大量回答对、却只能标注其中很小一部分的团队。它给出了让偏好数据选择依赖于不断演化的目标模型的具体做法，也提醒读者必须将梯度提取、投影和重复生成等运行成本，与人工标注一同纳入预算。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the acquisition equation and the experimental-labeling protocol together: the method is intended for humans to judge selected pairs, but the reported iterative experiments substitute reward-model labels after the initial datasets. The central reusable idea is not the exact 8,192-dimensional setting; it is the decision to select records using target-policy gradient uncertainty plus a mechanism that avoids repeatedly buying similar evidence.
应将获取方程与实验标注协议一起阅读：该方法原本意图让人工判断所选样本对，但报告的迭代实验会在初始数据集之后用奖励模型标签替代人工标签。可复用的核心思想不是精确的 8,192 维设置，而是用目标策略的梯度不确定性选择记录，并通过机制避免反复购买相似证据。
